correctness.rationale: The tensor-sum Laplacian splits into two layer parity spectra λ_j and λ_j+2w with simple or double cycle harmonics. Every collision is w=cos(2πj/n)-cos(2πk/n), so eigenspace maxima are exactly 2/3/4, with w=2 a 1+1 exception. Symmetric PBH provides lower bounds; explicit nonzero minors for consecutive spatial positions and opposite layers prove matching upper bounds and every 2-site iff gcd/parity criterion. The first n=5 four-actuator threshold is the exact radical identity. 18 exact rational Kalman checks and exact trigonometric identity replayed successfully, supplementary to the infinite proof.
